This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 27.01.2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Rheinland
Logistik GmbH, with its registered office at Berliner Allee 19, München ("Party A"), and Müller Industrietechnik GmbH, with its registered
office at Hauptstraße 42, Hamburg ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Signatures

Party A      Rheinland Logistik GmbH / Hans Schneider
Party B      Müller Industrietechnik GmbH / Jürgen Hoffmann
